title: THE FLIGHT OF THE CONDOR + THE RAINBOW MOUNTAIN
description: Discover the best of Peru on this 13-day accessible journey, specially designed for travelers of all abilities. From the vibrant streets of Lima to the elegant city of Arequipa, the majestic Colca Valley, and the sacred waters of Lake Titicaca—each destination offers unforgettable moments. Explore Cusco, marvel at the colors of Rainbow Mountain, and stand in awe before Machu Picchu, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Accessible hotels, transport & tours. Personalized support & expert guides. Comfort, safety, and cultural immersion at every step. Travel without limits. Peru awaits you. itinerary.title: Arrival in Lima – Welcome to Peru
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Lima International Airport, our team will be waiting to greet you with a warm welcome and provide comfortable, accessible transportation to your hotel in the city. Once settled in, you'll have some time to rest after your journey. Later, we'll meet for a briefing session at the hotel, where we'll go over the details of your adventure, answer any questions, and share helpful tips for the days ahead. You'll also receive any mobility equipment or support devices arranged for your trip, ensuring everything is ready for a safe and enriching experience. From the moment you land, we are here to support you with personalized, accessible service every step of the way. Welcome to Peru—your unforgettable journey begins now!

itinerary.title: Lima City Tour – Contrasts of the City of Kings
itinerary.description: Start your Peruvian adventure with a fascinating tour of Lima, the vibrant capital known as the City of Kings. Begin in the elegant coastal district of Miraflores, where you'll enjoy scenic ocean views and a panoramic stop at Huaca Pucllana, an ancient adobe pyramid that speaks to the city's pre-Columbian past. Then, journey into the heart of the Historic Center of Lima, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the colonial balconies, grand architecture, and charming plazas. Visit the beautiful Convent of Santo Domingo, home to centuries of spiritual and cultural history. A delicious lunch at a local restaurant is included, featuring a taste of Peru's world-famous cuisine. The tour is fully accessible, with adapted transportation and dedicated assistance to ensure comfort and inclusion at every stop. OPTIONAL: After Lunch Tour to the Larco Herrera Museum ($40 p/ person), Gastronomic tour and demo class ($70 p/ person). A day filled with history, flavor, and unforgettable first impressions of Peru.

itinerary.title: Flight to Arequipa & City Tour – The White City Awaits
itinerary.description: In the morning, we will transfer you to Jorge Chávez International Airport for your flight to Arequipa, known as La Ciudad Blanca for its stunning white volcanic stone architecture. Upon arrival, our team will greet you and provide accessible transportation to your hotel for check-in and a short rest. In the afternoon, enjoy a guided City Tour of Arequipa, where you'll explore its charming historic center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit iconic landmarks such as the Plaza de Armas, the beautiful Cathedral, and the impressive Santa Catalina Monastery, a city within a city filled with history and color. The tour includes accessible routes and personalized assistance to ensure comfort throughout the day. A perfect welcome to the Andes and a city full of elegance, history, and soul.

itinerary.title: Journey to the Colca Valley – Andean Landscapes & Local Flavors
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we'll depart from Arequipa towards the spectacular Colca Valley, one of the deepest canyons in the world and home to breathtaking scenery and traditional highland culture. Enjoy a scenic drive across the Salinas and Aguada Blanca Reserve, where you'll spot wild vicuñas, llamas, and alpacas grazing in the vast puna landscapes. Along the way, we'll stop at panoramic viewpoints like Patapampa, located over 4,900 meters above sea level, where the surrounding volcanoes rise majestically on the horizon. A delicious lunch featuring local ingredients is included in a traditional restaurant along the route. In the afternoon, arrive at your hotel in the Colca area, where you'll have time to rest, enjoy the peaceful mountain air, or take in the surroundings at your own pace. Overnight stay in the heart of the Andes, where nature, silence, and stars await.

itinerary.title: Colca Canyon & Journey to Puno – Condors and Highland Roads
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, we'll head to the iconic Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint to witness the majestic flight of the Andean condors as they soar gracefully above one of the deepest canyons on Earth. Along the way, you'll enjoy stunning views of the valley's pre-Inca terraces, snowcapped peaks, and traditional villages. After this unforgettable experience, we'll begin our journey across the Andean Altiplano toward Puno, located on the shores of Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world. A stop will be made for lunch en route (optional or included depending on final program), with time to rest and stretch along the scenic drive. Upon arrival in Puno, transfer to your accessible hotel for check-in and overnight stay. A day filled with nature, wildlife, and the changing colors of the Andes, ending by the sacred lake of the Incas.

itinerary.title: Lake Titicaca – Uros & Taquile Islands
itinerary.description: Explore the magic of Lake Titicaca on a full-day boat tour to the floating Uros Islands and the traditional island of Taquile. Start your day navigating the highest navigable lake in the world as you visit the unique Uros community, where locals live on handmade reed islands. Then continue to Taquile, known for its rich textile traditions and stunning lake views. Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch on Taquile Island, featuring local ingredients and Andean hospitality. The tour includes adapted assistance and personalized support to ensure a safe and inclusive experience on the water and the islands. Return to Puno in the late afternoon with unforgettable memories of Peru's living lake cultures.

itinerary.title: Overland, Cusco to Puno – Scenic Route with Cultural Stops
itinerary.description: Today, travel from Cusco to Puno along one of the most scenic and culturally rich routes in the Andes. This full-day road journey includes several fascinating stops along the way, offering a deeper look into Peru's history and highland landscapes. You'll visit traditional villages, ancient ruins, and beautiful viewpoints as we make our way south toward Lake Titicaca. A hearty buffet lunch is included in a picturesque Andean town, featuring local ingredients and traditional flavors. Accessible transportation and assistance are provided to ensure comfort throughout the day. Arrive in Puno by evening and settle into your hotel to rest and prepare for your Lake Titicaca adventure. Optional: Route Cusco to Puno by Train. Lunch and Folkloric Show Included. ($290 p/ person)

itinerary.title: Afternoon City Tour – Inca Capital Awaits
itinerary.description: This afternoon, we'll visit Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire nestled in the heart of the Andes. City Tour of Cusco, a journey through time and tradition. Visit the sacred Qoricancha, the Inca Temple of the Sun, and walk through the iconic Plaza de Armas, surrounded by colonial charm and lively culture. Then, explore the awe-inspiring fortress of Sacsayhuamán, followed by visits to Tambomachay and panoramic stops at Qenko and Puka Pukará, where the spirit of the Andes still lingers in every stone. Accessible transportation and personal support are provided to ensure your comfort throughout the day. A magical first glimpse into Cusco's living history and timeless majesty.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley Full Day – Pisac, Urubamba & Ollantaytambo
itinerary.description: Today you'll explore the breathtaking Sacred Valley of the Incas, a place where history, culture, and nature come together in perfect harmony. Start your day in Pisac, wandering through its colorful artisan market and admiring the terraced hillsides of its ancient ruins. Continue to Urubamba, where you'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch featuring local Andean flavors. In the afternoon, visit the impressive fortress of Ollantaytambo, a living Inca town filled with stories carved in stone. This day offers not only incredible views but also a deep connection with the spirit of the Andes. Accessible transportation and personal assistance are included to ensure a smooth and enriching experience for all. A day full of culture, flavors, and awe-inspiring beauty—straight from the heart of the Andes.

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain Full Day Tour | Accessible Experience
itinerary.description: Join us for an unforgettable accessible adventure to the stunning Rainbow Mountain! This full-day tour includes scenic views of the Andes, local encounters, and a delicious countryside lunch. Box lunch included for the journey featuring native corn, Andean potatoes, fresh cheese, and alpaca meat. Adapted support and assistance throughout the experience. Breathe in the beauty of the Peruvian highlands and witness one of nature's most colorful wonders—safely and comfortably.

itinerary.title: Living Culture in Cuper Bajo, Chinchero
itinerary.description: This morning, immerse yourself in the daily life of the Cuper Bajo community, located on the peaceful shores of Lake Piuray, high in the Andes of Chinchero. Be welcomed by local families and experience authentic Andean living culture through an enriching and hands-on exchange. Discover the ancient art of textile weaving—from shearing and spinning wool to learning how they create vibrant colors using natural dyes from native plants, minerals, and insects. You'll also explore their agricultural traditions, learning about the native crops they grow—such as potatoes, corn, and quinoa—and the deep connection they maintain with Pachamama (Mother Earth). The experience includes a delicious traditional Pachamanca lunch, where meats and vegetables are slow-cooked underground with hot stones—a true celebration of Andean flavors and community. This activity is designed to be accessible and inclusive, with adapted support to ensure comfort and full participation for every traveler. A morning of culture, nature, and connection—shared with the warm hearts of the Andes. Optionals: - Accessible ATV off road excursion around Piuray Lagoon ($35 p/ person) - Day with shaman, energetic cleansing and payment to the earth for prosperity ($65 p/ person)

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu Full Day Tour | From Cusco & Back
itinerary.description: Today, you'll embark on a full-day adventure to the majestic citadel of Machu Picchu. Early in the morning, we'll transfer you from your hotel to the train station for a scenic journey through the Sacred Valley. Upon arrival in Aguas Calientes, you'll take a short bus ride up the mountain to reach the entrance of Machu Picchu. Enjoy a guided tour of this iconic Inca sanctuary, adapted to your pace and needs, with plenty of time to take in the breathtaking views and history. After exploring the site, return to Aguas Calientes for a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before heading back to Cusco by train and private transfer. Accessible assistance provided throughout the day for a smooth and enriching experience. Optional: - Panoramic train service ($100 per person, round trip, includes support staff to assist you on the train) - Luxury Hiram Bingham Train service, includes brunch, Lunch and happy hour ($1275 per person, round trip. Includes support staff to assist you on the train)

itinerary.title: Time to say Good Bye...
itinerary.description: After 13 incredible days discovering the soul of Peru—its colors, flavors, landscapes, and people—it's time to say goodbye, but not farewell forever. This morning, we'll accompany you to Cusco Airport, where you'll board your flight back to Lima to connect with your international journey home. As your adventure ends, we hope your heart is full of unforgettable moments, meaningful connections, and a deep bond with this magical land. Thank you for letting us be part of your journey. It has been a true honor to travel with you. We'll be waiting with open arms whenever you return. And like the Inca's says... TUPAYANCHIS K'AMA! - Until life meet us again… ¡Hasta pronto!
